日文.首段: 江ノ島電鉄500形電車（えのしまでんてつ500がたでんしゃ）は、江ノ島電鉄の電車。

章节.概要: 老朽化の進んだ300形の置き換え用として2006年（平成18年）から2編成導入された。製造は東急車輛製造。
章节.車体:
車体は、枕ハリと中ハリ以外はステンレス製とした江ノ電初のオールステンレス車両であるが、20形と同一の塗装が施された。なお日本国内においては、併用軌道が存在する路線に投入される車両としては初のオールステンレス車両である。
丸みを帯びた車体デザインは、江ノ電自身が1956年から2003年まで運行していた江ノ島鎌倉観光500形（初代500形）を意識して設計したこともあり、同形式を彷彿とさせる部分もある。公式サイトや記念乗車券でも同形式の写真などを併載している。
前面にはスカートを装着した。乗降用扉は両開き戸で、窓ガラスは複層構造とされ、凹凸は極力なくし、手指や被服の挟み込みを防止した。加えてドアチャイムも設けた。
章节.走行装置:
集電装置は各車先頭寄りにシングルアーム式パンタグラフを搭載している。屋根上中央部には1両につき出力24.42kWの集中式冷房装置と空調制御装置を配置した。江ノ電は海岸線沿いを走行する線形であるため、機器のカバーや主枠にステンレスを使用した。
制御装置は江ノ電初のVVVFインバータ制御（2レベルIGBT）が採用された。ただし、補助電源装置・空気圧縮機・蓄電池など一部の補助機器は501Fが304Fから、502Fが303Fから流用されている。台車も種車からの流用品であるが、従来の直流直巻電動機からかご形三相誘導電動機の搭載に対応し、また車体の電蝕防止の観点から絶縁を強化している。
制御装置は東洋電機製造製のATR-M460-RG695Aである。また、これも江ノ電では初の回生ブレーキも装備され、回生失効対策として発電ブレーキも併用されている。また、この制御器は架線電圧が直流750Vの路線にも小変更で対応出来るように設計されている。主電動機はTDK-6252-A（端子電圧440 V、電流106 A、周波数55 Hz、出力60 kW、定格回転数1,615 rpm）である。駆動装置は300形の更新工事で採用された中空カルダン駆動用のものをTD継手用に変更したKD-110-B-Mであり、小歯車周りは新製したが、歯車箱は廃車になった300形のものを流用している。
章节.その他:
車内自動放送装置についても、江ノ電初となる英語放送を併用したものが使用され、その後他の音声合成放送装置搭載編成でも英語放送が追加された。
ドアステッカーは501Fは丸型の、502Fは四角形の、それぞれ従来品とは異なる新しいデザインのものが採用された。なお、502Fで採用されたステッカーは、その後501Fや他形式にも貼付された。
扉上部の車内案内表示器は江ノ電では初採用の2基の液晶ディスプレイで、右側に路線案内、左側にDVDによる沿線案内が表示される。
章节.運用:
501Fが304Fの置き換え用として2006年（平成18年）3月27日より営業運転を開始。2年後の2008年3月31日に300形303Fの置き換え用として502Fが営業運転を開始した。
運用は各形式と共通で、他形式とも併結運転を行う。4両編成で運転する際、通常は連結面側のパンタグラフを下げ、先頭と最後尾の2基のみを上げて運転されるが、本形式が他車と4両編成を組む際（500形同士も含む）は、回生失効を防止するためか4基全てのパンタグラフを上げて運転されていた。現在は連結面のパンタグラフを下げた通常の運用になっている。

英文.首段: The Enoshima Electric Railway 500 series (えのしまでんてつ500がたでんしゃ) is an electric multiple unit (EMU) of Enoshima Electric Railway (Enoden).

章节.Overview: Two sets were introduced from 2006 (Heisei 18) to replace the aging 300 series. They were built by Tokyu Car Corporation.
章节.Body:
The body is Enoden's first all-stainless-steel car, made of stainless steel except for the bolster beams and center beams, but it was given the same livery as the 20 series. In Japan it is the first all-stainless-steel car to be introduced on a line that has street running.
The rounded body design was designed with an awareness of the Enoshima Kamakura Sightseeing 500 series (first-generation 500 series) that Enoden itself operated from 1956 to 2003, and there are parts reminiscent of that type. Photographs of that type are also carried together on the official website and on commemorative tickets.
A skirt was fitted to the front. The passenger doors are double-leaf doors, and the window glass was made double-glazed, minimizing surface irregularities to prevent fingers and clothing from being caught. In addition, a door chime was provided.
章节.Running equipment:
Each car carries a single-arm pantograph near the front. In the center of the roof, one car is fitted with a 24.42 kW centralized air-conditioning unit and an air-conditioning control device. Because Enoden runs along a coastal alignment, stainless steel was used for equipment covers and main frames.
The control device adopted VVVF inverter control (2-level IGBT), the first for Enoden. However, some auxiliary equipment such as the auxiliary power supply, air compressor, and storage battery was diverted from 304F for 501F and from 303F for 502F. The bogies are also diverted from the donor cars, but they accommodate the mounting of squirrel-cage three-phase induction motors instead of the conventional DC series-wound motors, and insulation has been strengthened from the viewpoint of preventing electrolytic corrosion of the body.
The control device is the ATR-M460-RG695A made by Toyo Denki Seizo. It is also equipped with regenerative braking, the first for Enoden, and dynamic (rheostatic) braking is used together as a measure against regenerative failure. This controller is also designed to be able to handle lines with an overhead line voltage of DC 750 V with minor modifications. The traction motors are TDK-6252-A (terminal voltage 440 V, current 106 A, frequency 55 Hz, output 60 kW, rated speed 1,615 rpm). The drive system is the KD-110-B-M, which is the hollow-shaft cardan drive adopted in the 300 series renewal work modified for TD couplings; the parts around the pinion were newly made, but the gear case was diverted from a scrapped 300 series car.
章节.Other:
As for the automatic in-car announcement system, one that also uses English announcements was adopted, a first for Enoden, and afterwards English announcements were added to other sets equipped with speech synthesis announcement devices as well.
For the door stickers, a new design different from the conventional ones was adopted: round for 501F and square for 502F. The sticker adopted on 502F was afterwards applied to 501F and other types as well.
The in-car information displays above the doors use two liquid-crystal displays, the first such adoption for Enoden; the right side shows route guidance and the left side shows line-side guidance by DVD.
章节.Operation:
501F began commercial operation on March 27, 2006 (Heisei 18) to replace 304F. Two years later, on March 31, 2008, 502F began commercial operation to replace the 300 series 303F.
Operation is common with each type, and it is operated coupled with other types as well. When operating as a four-car set, normally the pantographs on the coupled-face sides are lowered and only the two at the front and rear are raised, but when this type formed a four-car set with other cars (including 500 series with each other), all four pantographs were raised, apparently to prevent regenerative failure. Currently it is operated in the normal manner with the coupled-face pantographs lowered.

The Enoshima Electric Railway 500 series (えのしまでんてつ500がたでんしゃ) is an electric multiple unit (EMU) of Enoshima Electric Railway (Enoden).

== Overview ==

The rounded body design was designed with an awareness of the Enoshima Kamakura Sightseeing 500 series (first-generation 500 series) that Enoden itself operated from 1956 to 2003, and there are parts reminiscent of that type. Photographs of that type are also carried together on the official website and on commemorative tickets.
A skirt was fitted to the front. The passenger doors are double-leaf doors, and the window glass was made double-glazed, minimizing surface irregularities to prevent fingers and clothing from being caught. In addition, a door chime was provided.

=== Running equipment ===
Each car carries a single-arm pantograph near the front. In the center of the roof, one car is fitted with a 24.42 kW centralized air-conditioning unit and an air-conditioning control device. Because Enoden runs along a coastal alignment, stainless steel was used for equipment covers and main frames.
The control device adopted VVVF inverter control (2-level IGBT), the first for Enoden. However, some auxiliary equipment such as the auxiliary power supply, air compressor, and storage battery was diverted from 304F for 501F and from 303F for 502F. The bogies are also diverted from the donor cars, but they accommodate the mounting of squirrel-cage three-phase induction motors instead of the conventional DC series-wound motors, and insulation has been strengthened from the viewpoint of preventing electrolytic corrosion of the body.
The control device is the ATR-M460-RG695A made by Toyo Denki Seizo. It is also equipped with regenerative braking, the first for Enoden, and dynamic (rheostatic) braking is used together as a measure against regenerative failure. This controller is also designed to be able to handle lines with an overhead line voltage of DC 750 V with minor modifications. The traction motors are TDK-6252-A (terminal voltage 440 V, current 106 A, frequency 55 Hz, output 60 kW, rated speed 1,615 rpm). The drive system is the KD-110-B-M, which is the hollow-shaft cardan drive adopted in the 300 series renewal work modified for TD couplings; the parts around the pinion were newly made, but the gear case was diverted from a scrapped 300 series car.

=== Other ===
As for the automatic in-car announcement system, one that also uses English announcements was adopted, a first for Enoden, and afterwards English announcements were added to other sets equipped with speech synthesis announcement devices as well.
For the door stickers, a new design different from the conventional ones was adopted: round for 501F and square for 502F. The sticker adopted on 502F was afterwards applied to 501F and other types as well.

Currently it is operated in the normal manner with the coupled-face pantographs lowered.
